title: The Evaluation of Pre-Post Smoke Evacuation Uses on Surgical Smoke and Bio-Aerosols in Operating Rooms
brief_summary: This study aims to evaluate the pre-post smoke evacuation uses on surgical smoke and bio-aerosols particles in operating rooms at a university hospital, Thailand.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Surgical patients who receive head-neck or breast surgery or surgical patients who receive abdominal laparoscopic surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Emergency cases
